fact: On 8 June 2026 the Equatorial Guinea telecoms minister chaired a technical meeting reviewing roaming cero after the Gabon agreement entered into force, with Gabon users paying national tariffs for calls, SMS and data since the 10 November 2025 signing.
title: El Ministerio de Telecomunicaciones acelera el roaming cero en la CEMAC
publisher: Página Oficial del Gobierno de la República de Guinea Ecuatorial
